blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Djed is a Cardano native asset. Cardano's native-token model routes ordinary transfers through the ledger rather than an ERC-20-style token contract; the minting policy controls mint and burn operations, not arbitrary holder transfers. The official Djed documentation and technical review describe the ADA reserve, DJED mint/burn, and SHEN mechanisms without a holder blacklist or freeze path. Direct holder-balance blacklistability remains false. Native identity is policy 8db269c3ec630e06ae29f74bc39edd1f87c819f1056206e879a1cd61 / asset name 446a65644d6963726f555344. Official COTI FAQ also documents a ChainPort BNB wrapper, 0x157a74bba219b3a2e6c0a5732f84a3e372031cfe. BNB block 128504545 (2026-10-19T06:15:31Z) returned name DjedMicroUSD [via ChainPort.io], decimals 6 and totalSupply 22745.361806 DJED; block 128504791 (2026-10-19T06:17:22Z) has EIP-1967 implementation 0x104f3152d8ebfc3f679392977356962ff36566ac and nonzero admin 0xe317bf1cf456875f37f1d1c5a63848d0ab25653c. Its verified proxy is upgradeable, but wrapper supply is approximately 1.571588% of the Pharos API circulating quantity 1447285.368673238 DJED observed 2026-10-19, far below the 10% threshold. This denominator includes canonical circulation backing bridged tokens, rather than adding the wrapped liability a second time. Exact circulating classification is not independently reconciled, but the wrapper would require circulating supply below 227453.61806 DJED to become material. Native Cardano therefore represents approximately 98.428412% on this wrapper-adjusted measure. No declared parent or inherited mint parent exists. COTI identifies exogenous ADA as the sole reserve asset; the reserve test is 0% issuer/custodian exposed over 100% ADA. Retain No; BNB upgradeability is disclosed, not used to set the verdict.

oracleRisk.summary: COTI documents Djed's production oracle as one aggregator drawing from at least six external market sources. An exchange-rate update is accepted only when at least three sources are available; otherwise no update occurs. That shared ADA/USD rate governs system-wide mint, redemption, and reserve-ratio accounting rather than borrower liquidations.

branchApplicability.rationale: Djed has one shared ADA reserve and no borrower-specific collateral positions or liquidations. Its aggregated ADA/USD exchange rate prices protocol-wide DJED/SHEN mint and redemption and the 400%-800% reserve gates, so that complete price-sensitive path belongs at top level.
